title: Identity & Crypto Gateways: Acceptance Checklist, PRD clarifications, and Scope-change Log for Private Deploy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket consolidates PRD-level clarifications, a scoped change log, and a prescriptive acceptance checklist for Identity (SSO/SAML/SCIM), RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM controls for Private deployments (VPC and on-prem). The goal is to provide deterministic sign-off criteria that enable engineering, security, and customer success to validate compliance posture before GA. Deliverables: (1) finalized acceptance checklist; (2) scope-change log with decisions and rollback triggers; (3) test plan and runbook snippets for sign-off verification; (4) handoff notes for SC and Support. Avoids rework by capturing open PRD questions and agreed constraints on scope (e.g., SCIM optional, HSM optional for Starter tier).
acceptance_criteria: SSO: SAML 2.0 metadata exchange verified with two IdPs (Okta and Azure AD) using production metadata; metadata rotation test performed and documented
SSO: IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows succeed; SSO time-to-first-byte < 1.5s for metadata-validated flows in private network emulation
RBAC: Role matrix implemented (Admin, DevOps, Viewer, Billing, Support) with least-privilege policies; permissions mapping documented and enforced via API
RBAC: Service principals and token scopes are audited; principal impersonation is logged and testable

Audit Logs: Audit stream contains creation/update/delete events for identity and keying operations with actor, timestamp, resource_id, and request_id; 90-day retention default, configurable to 365 days
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key provisioning flow validated for envelope encryption; HSM-backed wrap/unwrap tested on on-prem node with successful attestations
KMS: Key rotation exercised with zero-downtime target for serving (< 5% error spike/1-minute recovery) and documented rollback steps
Operational Playbooks: Emergency key revoke, IdP metadata rollback, and RBAC reversion executed in staging and documented
Privacy & Compliance: No plaintext customer secrets logged; PII redaction in operational logs verified
Upgrade Compatibility: Private control plane upgrade preserves active key bindings and RBAC assignments across minor versions

2026-03-03: Change - Default audit retention set to 90 days (configurable to 365) after infra cost analysis

Impact notes: SCIM delay reduces test surface for automated user provisioning but lowers initial integration work. HSM optional reduces hardware procurement dependencies for early customers.
test_plan: Identity tests: end-to-end SAML flows (IdP/SP) against Okta and Azure AD using private network emulator; include signed assertions, SLOA, audience checks
Metadata rotation: publish rotated metadata and validate existing sessions remain stable; execute automated rollback to prior metadata
RBAC policy tests: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests for API permission enforcement, and simulated privilege-escalation attempts
Audit log tests: inject known events, assert schema fields present, verify retention settings via snapshot queries
KMS/HSM tests: envelope encryption roundtrip; HSM attestation log capture; simulate key compromise and run emergency key-revoke scenario
Upgrade test: perform control-plane minor version upgrade preserving key bindings and RBAC mappings; verify no auth regressions
Chaos scenarios: intermittent KMS latency and IdP unavailability to validate fallbacks and SLA behavior
